rankingModelGuardrails.platinumD1: D1/Platinum teams anchor the top ranking bands. D1 teams generally stay above Gold teams unless they are consistently at the bottom and the Gold team has strong validation.
rankingModelGuardrails.goldD2: Top Gold/D2 teams can pass the bottom D1 teams only with strong head-to-head/key-win evidence and recent form.
rankingModelGuardrails.silverD3: Top Silver/D3 teams can pass lower Gold teams only with clear supporting evidence; Silver success alone does not create a D1 ranking.
